headline: Dominican Republic president announces Amber Highway construction
summary: Dominican Republic President Luis Abinader announced that construction of the Amber Highway will begin within 15 days following an initial budget allocation of RD$5.78 billion.
why: Large infrastructure investments stimulate domestic construction activity, employment, and regional economic development.

impacts.why: Government infrastructure spending directly supports domestic economic activity.
